analysis.narrativeEn:

· Position vs SMA100/200 ($403.66/$431.83) — Maintaining medium-to-long-term trend strength

· RSI trajectory (74.5→78.1) + Entering overbought + Continuing upward momentum

· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low maintained, attempting to break 5-day high) + Continuing uptrend
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.58x) + Reduced confidence in price movement
· Current phase diagnosis (Uptrend) + 1x allocation filled, further leverage entry contingent on conditions met
